SHWETA SHARMA

Senior Software Engineer

 sshwetas.7294@gmail.com	 +91-7620946033 Gurgaon / Bangalore / Pune / Remote	LinkedIn

Senior Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience in Java (8-17), Spring Boot, Microservices, and cloud-native development. Proven expertise in designing, developing, and deploying scalable backend solutions on Azure and AWS using Kubernetes and Docker.

Skilled in CI/CD pipeline automation, API security (OAuth2, JWT), and system performance optimization. Adept at applying design patterns and object-oriented design principles to deliver high- quality software in an Agile environment. Strong leadership in mentoring teams, conducting design reviews, and driving technical delivery. Deep expertise in Enterprise Content Management (ECM) provides a strategic edge for large-scale data and workflow automation initiatives, with a recent focus on leveraging Generative Al for enhanced content understanding and processing.

Languages & Frameworks — Java (8-17), Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Cloud, Java EE, Microservices, RESTful APIs, SOAP, Service Discovery, OAuth2/JWT

Cloud & DevOps — Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Jenkins, Maven, Git, GitHub, Helm, SonarQube, CAST

AI/ML — Completed Google Generative Al Leadership certification Databases & Messaging — SQL, NoSQL (MongoDB), Oracle, JMS, Kafka Testing & Quality — JUnit, Mockito, TDD, Integration Testing, Code Reviews

Methodologies — Agile, Scrum, SDLC, Object-Oriented Design (OOD), Design Patterns

Domain Expertise — Enterprise Content Management (Alfresco), Workflow Automation

Senior Associate, Cognizant	10/2021 – Present | Gurgaon Architected and developed 12+ RESTful microservices using Spring Boot and Java 11, reducing document ingestion time by 35%.

Designed a fault-tolerant microservices platform with Spring Cloud, API Gateway, and OAuth2 security to handle high-volume traffic.

Cognizant Vibe Coding GenAI Hackathon - Built an end-to-end application that, given a data model context, generates SQL queries from natural language or voice inputs. Enabled query execution and result visualization, including charts and graphical representations. Utilized Generative AI, NLP, and speech-to-text to deliver an interactive data analysis tool within the campaign timeline.



Containerized Java applications using Docker and orchestrated them on Kubernetes/Azure, increasing deployment frequency by 40%.

Automated end-to-end CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Maven, cutting release cycles from 2 days to 30 mins.

Led technical design reviews and mentored 3 junior engineers in TDD and code quality best practices, raising code coverage to 85%.

Refactored and optimized Java-based workflows during a platform upgrade (Alfresco v7.2 -> v25.1), enhancing scalability.

Senior Software Developer, Accenture	04/2019 – 10/2021 | Pune Engineered scalable search solutions using Java-backed Solr/Elasticsearch for an ECM system managing over 5 million documents.

Developed Spring Boot services for workflow automation and metadata extraction from ECM repositories.

Applied DevOps best practices with Jenkins integration, reducing manual deployment effort by 25 hours per month.

Designed and scheduled batch jobs using Spring Scheduler for bulk data uploads and operational automation.

Participated in technical design reviews, ensuring new feature development aligned with enterprise coding standards.

Associate Consultant, Wipro	11/2018 – 03/2019 | Pune Built Java utilities for database-to-Excel ETL processes using Apache POI, accelerating reporting by 50%.

Integrated OCR with Abbyy FlexiCapture for automated content ingestion within ECM workflows.

Java Developer, Tata Consultancy Services	03/2016 – 10/2018 | Gandhinagar Created robust document management APIs in Java EE, handling 15K+ daily requests for upload, search, and version control.

Migrated legacy Ant builds to Maven, standardizing the build process and improving build reliability by 70%.

Configured an enterprise system on Linux with Oracle 12c and LDAP, ensuring secure deployment.

Google Generative Al Leader, ACE — Alfresco Certified Engineer, AZ-900 — Azure Fundamentals, Kubernetes (Udemy)

Bachelor of Engineering (BE), Nagpur University	2011 – 2015
